prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1109; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center and the left tail lamp assembly is broken, with the trunk lid and rear panel showing crease lines consistent with the reported impact. Damage is confined to the rear section and the pattern lines up with a straight-on rear collision. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and tail lamp, repairing the trunk lid, and refinishing the affected panels. The labor hours requested fit the scope of this damage, and the invoiced line items show no repeated charges. We have no record or sign of earlier damage to this vehicle in the area being repaired. Recommend approval as submitted.
